title: 契约测试只查「有 upload-artifact 且路径含 report.json」，没守住 `if: always()` 与 --keep-workdir，证据上传可被静默破坏
evidence: test_nightly_workflow_is_scheduled_and_manual_only 里只做：`uploads = [step for step in steps if "upload-artifact" in str(step.get("uses", ""))]`、`assert uploads`、`assert "report.json" in str(uploads[0].get("with", {}).get("path", ""))`（tests/test_agent_ui_smoke_contract.py:202-204）。workflow 里真正决定「失败也能拿到证据」的两处约束都没被断言：(1) `.github/workflows/agent-ui-smoke.yml:46` 的 `if: always()`；(2) 运行步骤 :43 的 `--keep-workdir`（run_smoke.py:403-405 在成功且未带该参数时会 `shutil.rmtree(workdir)`，删掉的就是要被上传的目录）。删掉其中任意一个，nightly 失败时证据消失，而契约测试仍全绿——这条测试的用途正是防这类回归。
suggestion: 把断言补成：`assert str(uploads[0].get("if", "")).strip().lower() == "always()"`；`path = str(uploads[0].get("with", {}).get("path", ""))` 后 `assert "run.json" in path and "*.log" in path`；再 `assert any("--keep-workdir" in run for run in runs)`（runs 已在 :200 建好）。这样 upload 语义的四个关键点（存在、always、run.json+日志、保留目录）才都被守住。
